info.title: Channel dashboard — live API only
info.seed: +963900000001 — role channel_manager on demo-channel (id 1). OTP_BYPASS=true: any code verifies. Without bypass, random 6 digits (not all zeros — zeros are rep-* only).
info.not: This is NOT the platform admin (guard platform, port 3000) and NOT the warehouse / Flutter apps.
info.rule: If this file and the catalog disagree, this file wins. Call only live:true. Never call forbidden. Never mock missing retailer/warehouse/product-show lists. Gate screens with permissions[] from verify-otp, not role names.

headers.Authorization: Bearer {token} — required except GET /health, GET /public/refs, POST /channel/auth/*
headers.Accept-Language: ignored — SetAcceptLanguage forces locale en; map error.code in the UI
headers.X-Device-Id: stable UUID — rate-limit key on OTP request
headers.X-Idempotency-Key: UUID per user intent on every write except the two channel OTP paths
headers.X-Channel-Id: do not send — honoured only for platform_admin. Channel tenant comes from membership (defaultChannelId).

envelope.money: integer minor units everywhere except GET/POST /channel/zones delivery_fee and min_order_value (decimal strings, 2 places). SYP decimals = 0. Never /100.
envelope.sort: never send sort — lists use defaultSort; Spatie rejects unknown sorts
envelope.not_found: 404 means missing OR not yours — never render forbidden
envelope.permissions: Hide nav items with can(code) from verify-otp.permissions. Do not branch on role name (channel_manager / sales_manager / …).
envelope.dual_approval: adjust / credit-note / void may return {approval_request_id} with meta.requires_dual_approval. A second user resubmits the same body plus approval_request_id + approval_reason. Same user → 403 sod_violation.

forbidden.reason: No retailer list / approval / 360. PUT /channel/retailers/{id}/credit still live — type the id.
No warehouse directory on this guard. Inventory takes warehouse_id as an integer.
No product show. List is id/sku/name_ar/status only.
No offer show / PUT. List + POST + PATCH stop + GET performance.
Channel IAM is not seeded. Users and roles are platform-only.
No logout route. Clear the token locally.
No me/session. verify-otp is the session.
No media upload on any guard.
Wrong guard. Never call retailer or rep routes from this dashboard.
Export returns job_id. No job-status poll route.

gotchas: No POST /channel/auth/logout. Discard the token locally. There is no GET /channel/me — the session is the verify-otp payload (token, channels[], permissions[]).
X-Channel-Id is ignored for channel users. channels[] from login is display-only — no tenant switch API on this guard.
OTP_BYPASS (non-production) accepts any code. Without it, channel codes are random 6 digits, not 000000. X-Client channel-web does not get the rep all-zero shortcut.
GET /channel/products list rows are only id, sku, name_ar, status. There is no GET /channel/products/{id}. PUT uses the create body; re-GET the list after save.
GET /channel/offers list rows are only id, name, type, status. There is no GET /channel/offers/{id}. Performance is a separate path. conversion_rate and net_margin are always 0.

GET /channel/invoices list rows are only id, no, total, status. There is no invoice show. Credit-note lines[].line_id has no list of invoice lines — keep the line_id from the sub-order that minted it, or do not build a line picker.
No GET /channel/retailers and no GET /channel/warehouses. Credit, office payment, inventory adjust/transfer take integer ids typed or copied. Do not invent a directory.
No media upload on any guard. media_id / logo / banner / image are opaque strings. Store them as text; do not POST a file except catalog import.
POST /channel/catalog/import is multipart: file + type=products + optional dry_run. JSON body is 422.
GET/POST /channel/zones delivery_fee and min_order_value are decimal strings ("12.50"), not int money. Unique exception on this guard.
DELETE /channel/zones/{id} is 204 empty body.
PUT /channel/content/intro returns {enabled} only — re-GET for the form.
Banner stats.ctr is integer basis points at scale 10^4 (840 clicks / 12000 impressions = 700), never a 0.07 float. Catalog sample is wrong.
GET /channel/dashboard KPIs are 0 / empty until DailySnapshot has a row. Never fabricate GMV. meta.snapshot_date may be null.

GET /channel/reports/{type} ignores date_from/date_to — it reads the latest snapshot block. Unknown type still 200 with empty rows. Allowed types: sales|products|retailers|reps|zones|inventory|finance|offers|operations.
GET /channel/finance/aging echoes group_by (zone|rep) but buckets are global sums of open invoices — not split by zone or rep.

POST /channel/inventory/adjust, credit-note and void may return approval_request_id instead of the mutation. Replay from a second user. channel_manager is exempt from SOD-01; still do not hide the payment button.
POST /channel/payments is SOD-01 vs sc.orders.confirm → 403 sod_violation unless the user is channel_manager.
Rep id everywhere (assign, settle, wallet, discount-cap, filter[rep_id]) is AppUser id from GET /channel/reps, not RepProfile id.
filter[waiting_over_minutes] on sub-orders is a custom query (not Spatie AllowedFilter) and still works as filter[waiting_over_minutes].

GET /public/refs (no auth) is the picker for activity_types, sale_units, root_categories, equipments. Shared GET /governorates|/zones|/currencies need a channel Bearer. Do not call /platform/refs/* (wrong_guard).
Category POST parent_id is required ≥1. Tree roots are platform root_categories (level 1); channel categories hang under them.

Unpaginated arrays (no page in meta): category tree, coverage zones, sliders, loyalty rules, notification templates, dashboard, aging, report, margins, settings, intro, offer performance, banner stats, wallet.

endpoints.name: Health check
endpoints.description: Public liveness. No tenant, no auth.

endpoints.name: GET /currencies
endpoints.note: Needs Bearer. decimals governs display; amounts stay int. is_base is never returned.

endpoints.name: GET /governorates
endpoints.note: Needs a channel (or any) Bearer. Paginated. search is top-level. filter[status] works. Do not call /platform/refs/governorates from this app (wrong_guard).

endpoints.name: Public reference snapshot
endpoints.description: Registration screens cache this locally and refresh by cursor (REQ-AD-032, REQ-CM-016).
endpoints.note: No auth. Use for activity_types, sale_units, root_categories, equipments pickers. Channels are never in this payload (REQ-IN-06). Merge by id; drop status!=active.

endpoints.name: GET /zones
endpoints.note: Needs Bearer. Paginated. Shared read — not the channel coverage table (that is GET /channel/zones).

endpoints.name: Channel request OTP
endpoints.note: Body is {phone} only. X-Device-Id is the rate-limit key. Exempt from idempotency.

endpoints.name: Channel verify OTP
endpoints.description: Returns channel list when the user belongs to more than one.
endpoints.note: Body {otp_id, code as string}. No device_id. Unknown phone / no membership → 403 insufficient_permission. Stay on the login screen.

endpoints.name: Own channel settings
endpoints.note: Live, no catalog row. SupplyChannelResource. allowed_next is for platform transitions — do not render those buttons here; this guard cannot POST /platform/channels/{id}/transition.

endpoints.name: Update own channel
endpoints.note: Partial. name/legal_name/tax_number/phone/email/settings. Cannot change status or slug.

endpoints.name: Channel dashboard
endpoints.note: Zeros / empty arrays until reporting writes DailySnapshot. meta.snapshot_date may be null. Never invent KPIs.

endpoints.name: Channel report
endpoints.description: type ∈ sales|products|retailers|reps|zones|inventory|finance|offers|operations
endpoints.note: Path type ∈ sales|products|retailers|reps|zones|inventory|finance|offers|operations. Query dates are ignored. Unknown type → empty rows 200.

endpoints.name: Import catalog
endpoints.note: multipart/form-data: file, type=products, optional dry_run. Not JSON.

endpoints.name: Create category
endpoints.description: 422 at the 6th level.

endpoints.name: Update product
endpoints.note: Same FormRequest as POST (name_ar + sku required). media_id strings — no upload.

endpoints.name: List products
endpoints.note: List shape is thin: id, sku, name_ar, status. Filters: filter[brand_id|category_id|status|zone_id|search]. No GET show.

endpoints.name: Create product
endpoints.description: All money fields are integer minor units (BR-AD-18). 12000 ≠ 120.00.

endpoints.name: Create price list
endpoints.description: type: base|zone|group|retailer. Precedence: retailer_price ← group_list ← zone_list ← qty_tier ← base_price.

endpoints.name: Offer performance
endpoints.note: net_margin and conversion_rate are always 0 (no cost / no views). Do not display them as real rates.

endpoints.name: Create offer
endpoints.description: type: product_discount|invoice_discount|buy_x_get_y|bundle|tiered_discount|gift. Deleting a line in the offer removes the whole offer (BR-08).

endpoints.name: Adjust inventory
endpoints.note: May return {approval_request_id} + meta.requires_dual_approval instead of movement_id. qty_delta is signed int.

endpoints.name: Inventory movements
endpoints.description: Immutable ledger with balance before/after.

endpoints.name: Create transfer
endpoints.description: Statuses: sent then received.

endpoints.name: Assign to rep
endpoints.description: mode: manual|auto|bulk_zone. 422 if rep is off-duty or outside zones (BR-19).

endpoints.name: Bulk confirm
endpoints.description: Up to 50 ids. Target: 50 orders under 2 minutes.
endpoints.note: Max 50 ids. Partial success is 200 with confirmed[] and failed[].

endpoints.name: Cancel sub-order
endpoints.description: Releases reservation.

endpoints.name: Confirm sub-order
endpoints.description: Reserves stock, creates picking list, reveals channel name to retailer.

endpoints.name: Edit sub-order lines
endpoints.description: Mandatory retailer notification.

endpoints.name: Reassign sub-order
endpoints.description: Forbidden after handover is received.

endpoints.name: Reject sub-order
endpoints.description: Immediate retailer notification.

endpoints.name: Schedule sub-order
endpoints.description: Synced to the rep calendar.

endpoints.name: Sub-order detail
endpoints.note: Drive confirm/reject/edit buttons from allowed_actions, not from a hardcoded status map.

endpoints.name: List sub-orders
endpoints.description: Grouped by zone with warning colors in UI.

endpoints.name: Decide return request
endpoints.description: Financial and stock impact per BR-13. decision: approve|reject.

endpoints.name: Decide rep-sourced shop
endpoints.description: decision: approve|reject. Approve activates RetailerProfile and marks shop linked.

endpoints.name: Decide rep zone request
endpoints.description: decision: approve|reject. Approve attaches zone to RepProfileZone.

endpoints.name: Approve rep
endpoints.description: pending_review → active. reason optional. Illegal transition → 409.

endpoints.name: Disable rep
endpoints.description: active → disabled. reason required.

endpoints.name: Rep discount cap
endpoints.description: Exceeding cap at submit → 403 discount_cap_exceeded (BR-12).
endpoints.note: max_discount_percent 0–100 int. max_cash_hold int minor units, 0 = no cap.

endpoints.name: Reject rep
endpoints.description: pending_review → rejected. reason required.

endpoints.name: Settle rep wallet
endpoints.description: Invariant: wallet.net_balance == SUM(collected) − SUM(settled) (AC-06).

endpoints.name: Rep wallet (channel read)
endpoints.description: Same ledger math as GET /app/rep/wallet. Foreign channel → 404.

endpoints.name: Show rep
endpoints.description: Foreign channel rep → 404.

endpoints.name: List reps
endpoints.description: id is AppUser id (same as assign / settle / discount-cap). status: pending_review|active|rejected|disabled.
endpoints.note: id is AppUser id. filter[status]=pending_review|active|rejected|disabled. Same id for assign / settle / discount-cap / wallet.

endpoints.name: Receivables aging
endpoints.description: group_by: zone|rep
endpoints.note: group_by=zone|rep is echoed; buckets are NOT grouped — global remaining on open invoices.

endpoints.name: Issue credit note
endpoints.note: Dual-approval eligible. lines[].line_id has no invoice-detail API — do not build a line picker from a missing show.

endpoints.name: Record office payment
endpoints.description: SOD-01: must not be held together with sc.orders.confirm.
endpoints.note: SOD-01: 403 sod_violation if the same user also has sc.orders.confirm, unless channel_manager. method ∈ cash|bank|card. amount int.

endpoints.name: Retailer credit limit
endpoints.description: on_exceed: warn|block|manual_approval. Confirm may return 423 credit_limit_exceeded.

endpoints.name: Remove coverage row
endpoints.note: 204 No Content. Foreign coverage id → 404.

endpoints.name: Channel coverage
endpoints.note: Unpaginated coverage rows. delivery_fee and min_order_value are decimal strings. Path param on DELETE is the coverage row id (channel_zone), not zone_id.

endpoints.name: Add coverage row
endpoints.note: Upsert by zone_id. delivery_days ∈ sun…sat. Fees are decimal:0,2 not int money.

endpoints.name: Banner stats
endpoints.note: ctr is integer basis points × 10^4. 0 when impressions=0. Catalog float 0.07 is wrong.

endpoints.name: Update intro screen
endpoints.note: Response is {enabled} only. Re-GET to refill the form. Empty store: enabled false.

endpoints.name: Create slider
endpoints.description: source: manual|brand|category|offers|algorithm. algorithm: new_arrivals|best_selling|most_ordered_by_retailer|suggested|similar|same_brand.
